description: Clock divider counting incoming pulses 1 to 8 over and over, with eight outputs firing on the counts that divide by their own number

inputs.text: Each rise past 1.7V advances the count; the first pulse after a reset only measures the interval, and counting starts on the one after it
A rise past 1.7V sets the count back to the start; the next pulse after it measures the interval and counting resumes on the one after that

outputs.text: Goes high on each count that divides by its own number and falls after half the last clock interval, carrying the CLOCK input's own voltage rather than the fixed 1.7V the manual states

notes: nothing comes out until a clock is patched to CLOCK, and the first pulse after the module is added or reset only measures the interval, so the outputs start on the second pulse
the lamp beside an output is lit while that output is high
the count is not written into the patch file, so it starts from the beginning each time the patch is loaded
